text.text: For the holy spirit of discipline will flee deceit, and remove from thoughts that are without understanding, and will not abide when unrighteousness cometh in.
They knew not his statutes, nor walked in the ways of his commandments, nor trod in the paths of discipline in his righteousness.
He openeth also their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity.
He hath mercy on them that receive discipline, and that diligently seek after his judgments.
Whoso feareth the Lord will receive his discipline; and they that seek him early shall find favour.
